hero.intro: A cartridge valve screws into a machined cavity in a manifold block, so a whole circuit can live in one compact body with no pipework between the valves. Sun Hydraulics builds each function in frame sizes from series 0 to series 4; the series sets the cavity and the flow, and the configuration letters after the model code set the control, setting range, seals and material.

guidance.heading: Function first, then frame size and cavity
guidance.body: Pick the function — hold a load, limit pressure, meter flow, check or switch direction — then the flow you need, which fixes the series and the cavity. Send us the model code from the valve or the drawing, or the duty (flow, pressure, fluid and what the valve has to do), and we confirm the full ordering code with the quotation.

products.title: Sun Hydraulics Mechanically Operated, Back-to-Back Check Valve — CDAP, CDAQ, Series 0
products.descriptionShort: Sun Hydraulics Mechanically Operated, Back-to-Back Check Valve: CDAP, CDAQ, series 0, 1.25 gpm (4,7 L/min), T-162DP cavity. Authorised Sun Hydraulics distributor, UAE — supplied direct from Sun.
products.descriptionLong:
Two checks back to back in one cartridge, built to sit inside a cylinder piston. At the end of the stroke a stop pushes the port-1 poppet off its seat, oil passes through the piston and two cylinders working in series come back into step. Sun calls it a phaser check.

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in 2 versions:

  • CDAP — series 0, T-162DP cavity, 1.25 gpm (4,7 L/min)
  • CDAQ — series 0, T-162DP cavity, 1.25 gpm (4,7 L/min)

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series.

Ratings

  • Maximum operating pressure: 5000 psi (350 bar)
  • Maximum leakage: 1 drops/min. (0,07 cc/min)

Configuration options

The letters after the base model code choose these options (shown for CDAQ; a size may add or drop a choice):

  • Control: M — Mechanical Actuation
  • Check cracking pressure: C — 30 psi (2 bar)
  • Seal material: N — Buna-N, V — Viton

Selection notes

  • The push must be axial and square to the valve within 5°; it cannot take side load and is not meant to be cam-operated.
  • It is not a mechanical stop: limit poppet travel to 0.047 in (1.2 mm) with a separate stop.
  • Installation needs Sun's special tool 998-101; port 2 of the cavity is not used.

Where it is used

Re-phasing master-slave and series cylinders on lifts, platforms and agricultural implements.

Installation and seal kits

Hex 3/4 in. (19,1 mm); installation torque 20 - 25 lbf ft (27 - 33 Nm). Replacement seal kits — series 0: Buna: 990162007, Viton: 990162006, Polyurethane: 990162002.

Ordering

Indus Hydraulics is an authorised Sun Hydraulics distributor in the UAE and supplies the range direct from Sun Hydraulics. Quote the base model and its configuration letters — for example CDAQMCN — or describe the duty and we select the part. We confirm the full ordering code with the quotation.

faqs.question: How does it bring cylinders back into step?
faqs.answer: When the leading cylinder reaches the end of its stroke, the valve is pushed open and oil passes through its piston to the next cylinder until that one bottoms out too, so both start the next stroke together.

faqs.question: How tight is the check when it is closed?
faqs.answer: Very tight: the published maximum is under one drop a minute. If a load starts to drift through a check that used to hold, the seat has usually been marked by dirt and the cartridge should be replaced.

faqs.question: What does the full Sun model code mean?
faqs.answer: The four letters are the base model: valve type, frame size and variant. The letters that follow choose the control, setting range, seal material and any material or coating option. We confirm the full code, for example CDAQMCN, with the quotation.

faqs.question: How do I order or get a quotation?
faqs.answer: Send us the Sun model code — from the valve itself or the machine drawing — with the quantity, or describe the duty if you are choosing a new valve. We confirm the full ordering code, price and delivery with the quotation. Indus Hydraulics is an authorised Sun Hydraulics distributor in the UAE.

faqs.question: Which parts of the cartridge can be serviced?
faqs.answer: Only the external seals. Sun supplies a seal kit for every cartridge, and the kit numbers for this valve are listed under Installation and seal kits. Fitting a different external seal material does not make the valve compatible with a new fluid, because the internal seals stay as built.

faqs.question: How is the cartridge installed?
faqs.answer: It screws into a cavity machined to Sun's drawing for its series, and is tightened to the installation torque given in the specifications. Main stages with an integral T-8A pilot cavity go in first, and the pilot cartridge is then fitted into them to its own torque.

This version

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in one version:

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Ratings

  • Maximum leakage: 1 drops/min. (0,07 cc/min)

Configuration options

The letters after the base model code choose these options (shown for CXBG; a size may add or drop a choice):

  • Control: X — Not Adjustable
  • Check cracking pressure: A — 4 psi (0,3 bar), B — 15 psi (1 bar), C — 30 psi (2 bar), D — 50 psi (3,5 bar)
  • Seal material: L — Extended Temp. Buna, N — Buna-N, V — Viton, E — EPDM

Option rules: EPDM seals are not allowed on modifier /AP or /LH; If the modifier is /AP, the control must be X; If the modifier is /LH, the control must be X; If the seal is E, the control must be X.

Pump outlet checks, load-holding checks in a manifold, isolating one branch of a circuit from another.

products.descriptionLong:
A check cartridge that passes oil freely from the side (port 2) into the nose (port 1) and blocks the reverse. In a 3-port cavity the third port is blanked, so the valve works as a plain 2-port check where a 3-port cavity has been machined.

This version

  • A bypass orifice, sized to order, lets a controlled flow pass in the checked direction; its diameter is stamped on a hex face.
  • Port 3 is blocked, so it works as a 2-port check in a 3-port cavity.

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in 4 versions:

  • CNCD — series 1, T-11A cavity, 15 gpm (60 L/min)
  • CNED — series 2, T-2A cavity, 30 gpm (120 L/min)
  • CNGD — series 3, T-17A cavity, 60 gpm (240 L/min)
  • CNID — series 4, T-19A cavity, 120 gpm (480 L/min)

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series.

Ratings

  • Maximum operating pressure: 5000 psi (350 bar)
  • Bypass orifice range: .016 - .153 in. (0,4 - 3,9 mm), .016 - .135 in. (0,4 - 3,4 mm), .016 - .218 in. (0,4 - 5,5 mm)

Configuration options

products.title: Sun Hydraulics 2-Way, Direct-Acting, Fixed Setting, Directional Valve with Drain to Port 4, Normally Open — DRBMX
products.descriptionShort: Sun Hydraulics 2-Way, Direct-Acting, Fixed Setting, Directional Valve with Drain to Port 4, Normally Open: DRBMX, series 1, 7 gpm (28 L/min), T-21A cavity. Authorised Sun Hydraulics distributor, UAE — supplied direct from Sun.
products.descriptionLong:
A directional cartridge switched by pressure rather than a solenoid: it shifts once the pressure difference between port 1 and the drain passes its spring setting. It can switch a moderate flow itself or pilot a larger directional or logic cartridge. Being direct-acting, it leaks little and uses almost no pilot flow.

This version

  • Normally open.
  • The spring chamber drains to a separate port 4, so pressure at port 3 does not shift the setting and port 3 can work as a load port.
  • Fixed setting: the shift pressure is set at the factory to the value you order.

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in one version:

  • DRBMX — series 1, T-21A cavity, 7 gpm (28 L/min)

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series.

Ratings

  • Maximum operating pressure: 5000 psi (350 bar)
  • Maximum leakage: 2 in³/min. (30 cc/min)

Configuration options

The letters after the base model code choose these options (shown for DRBMX; a size may add or drop a choice):

  • Setting range: F — 100 psi (7 bar)
  • Seal material: N — Buna-N, V — Viton

Selection notes

  • It can modulate between positions; it is not a snap-acting switch.
  • For series 1 valves with a panel-mount handknob, cut a 0.75 in (19 mm) hole in the panel.

Where it is used

Pressure-sequenced switching — unloading, high-low pump circuits, interlocks, piloting logic elements.

Installation and seal kits

Hex 7/8 in. (22,2 mm); installation torque 30 - 35 lbf ft (41 - 47 Nm). Replacement seal kits — series 1: Buna: 990021007, Polyurethane: 990021002, Viton: 990021006.

Ordering

Indus Hydraulics is an authorised Sun Hydraulics distributor in the UAE and supplies the range direct from Sun Hydraulics. Quote the base model and its configuration letters — for example DRBMXFN — or describe the duty and we select the part. We confirm the full ordering code with the quotation.

faqs.question: Can port 3 be used as a work port?
faqs.answer: Not on the versions that drain internally to port 3, because pressure there adds to the setting (or opposes opening) one-for-one. Choose a version with a separate drain at port 4 where port 3 has to carry load pressure.

faqs.answer: Yes. Both fit the same cavity with the same flow path, so one can replace the other. The direct-acting valve leaks less and uses almost no pilot flow; the pilot-operated valve holds its setting more closely.

faqs.answer: No. It is not bistable: between the two positions it can sit part-way open and modulate, so it should be applied as a pressure-operated switch with that in mind, not as a detented valve.

products.descriptionLong:
A screw-in directional cartridge shifted by hand. A twist-lock or push operator moves the poppet or spool, so a function can be worked, overridden or isolated without electrical power.

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in one version:

  • DNDM — series 1, T-31A cavity, 10 gpm (40 L/min)

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series.

Ratings

  • Maximum operating pressure: 5000 psi (350 bar)
  • Maximum leakage: 10 in³/min.@3000 psi (160 cc/min.@210 bar)

Configuration options

The letters after the base model code choose these options (shown for DNDM; a size may add or drop a choice):

  • Control: D — Twist/Lock (Dual) Manual Override, L — Twist/Lock (Detent) Manual Override, T — Twist (Momentary) Manual Override
  • Spool / poppet configuration: C — Closed, Shift to Through, D — Closed, Shift to Cross, E — Cross, Shift to Closed, H — Open, Shift to Cross, N — Through, Shift to Cross, L — Cross, Shift to P to A, B and T Blocked, R — Regen, Shift to Cross, T — Tandem, Shift to Through, U — Through, Shift to Tandem, Y — Motor, Shift to Cross
  • Seal material: N — Buna-N, V — Viton, E — EPDM

Option rules: If the seal is E, the control must be D,L or T.

Selection notes

  • The manual operator is for occasional use — Sun quotes a life of about 10,000 cycles — and can be replaced in the field without removing the cartridge.
  • A momentary twist option returns to the rest position as soon as it is released.

Where it is used

Manual overrides, set-up and maintenance functions, emergency lowering, isolating a branch.

Installation and seal kits

A pilot-operated directional cartridge that shifts once the pressure difference between port 1 and the drain passes its setting. A small pilot stage sets the spool, so the switching point holds closely as flow changes. It can switch a moderate flow itself or pilot a larger directional or logic cartridge.

  • The spring chamber drains to a separate port 4, so pressure at port 3 does not shift the setting and port 3 can work as a load port.

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in 2 versions:

  • DPBN — series 1, T-21A cavity, 7 gpm (28 L/min)
  • DPCN — series 2, T-22A cavity, 15 gpm (60 L/min)

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow.   • Maximum leakage: 1 in³/min.@1000 psi (15 cc/min.@70 bar)

products.title: Sun Hydraulics 2-Way, Pilot-Operated, Directional Valve with Internal Drain to Port 3, Normally Open — DPBA, DPCA, Series 1 to 2
products.descriptionShort: Sun Hydraulics 2-Way, Pilot-Operated, Directional Valve with Internal Drain to Port 3, Normally Open: DPBA, DPCA, series 1 to 2, 7 gpm to 15 gpm (28 L/min to 60 L/min), T-11A, T-2A cavities. Authorised Sun Hydraulics distributor, UAE — supplied direct from Sun.
products.descriptionLong:
A pilot-operated directional cartridge that shifts once the pressure difference between port 1 and the drain passes its setting. A small pilot stage sets the spool, so the switching point holds closely as flow changes. It can switch a moderate flow itself or pilot a larger directional or logic cartridge.

This version

  • Normally open.
  • The spring chamber drains internally to port 3, so pressure at port 3 adds to the setting.

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in 2 versions:

  • DPBA — series 1, T-11A cavity, 7 gpm (28 L/min)
  • DPCA — series 2, T-2A cavity, 15 gpm (60 L/min)

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series.

Ratings

  • Maximum operating pressure: 5000 psi (350 bar)
  • Maximum leakage: 1 in³/min.@1000 psi (15 cc/min.@70 bar)
  • Control pilot flow: 7 - 10 in³/min. (0,11 - 0,16 L/min), 10 - 15 in³/min. (0,16 - 0,25 L/min)

Configuration options

The letters after the base model code choose these options (shown for DPBA; a size may add or drop a choice):

  • Control: C — Tamper Resistant - Factory Set, K — Handknob, L — Standard Screw Adjustment, O — Handknob with Panel Mount
  • Setting range: A — 100 - 3000 psi (7 - 210 bar), 1000 psi (70 bar) Standard Setting, B — 50 - 1500 psi (3,5 - 105 bar), 1000 psi (70 bar) Standard Setting, D — 25 - 800 psi (1,7 - 55 bar), 400 psi (28 bar) Standard Setting, E — 25 - 400 psi (1,7 - 28 bar), 200 psi (14 bar) Standard Setting, W — 150 - 4500 psi (10,5 - 315 bar), 1000 psi (70 bar) Standard Setting, C — 150 - 6000 psi (10,5 - 420 bar), 1000 psi (70 bar) Standard Setting, K — 75 - 1500 psi (5 - 105 bar), 1000 psi (70 bar) Standard Setting
  • Seal material: N — Buna-N, V — Viton
  • Material / coating: /AP — Stainless Steel, Passivated, /LH — Mild Steel, Zinc-Nickel

Option rules: If the modifier is /AP, the control must be C or L; If the modifier is /LH, the control must be C or L.

Selection notes

  • Keep port 3 at or below 3,000 psi (210 bar) on the internally drained versions; the limit is set by fatigue strength.
  • Pilot flow is small, about 7 to 10 in³/min on series 1.
  • For series 1 valves with a panel-mount handknob, cut a 0.75 in (19 mm) hole in the panel.

Where it is used

Pressure-sequenced switching — unloading, high-low pump circuits, interlocks, piloting logic elements.

Installation and seal kits

Hex 7/8 in. (22,2 mm), 1 1/8 in. (28,6 mm); installation torque 30 - 35 lbf ft (41 - 47 Nm), 45 - 50 lbf ft (61 - 68 Nm). Replacement seal kits — series 1: Buna: 990011007, Polyurethane: 990011002, Viton: 990011006; series 2: Buna: 990202007, Polyurethane: 990002002, Viton: 990202006.

Indus Hydraulics is an authorised Sun Hydraulics distributor in the UAE and supplies the range direct from Sun Hydraulics. Quote the base model and its configuration letters — for example DPBALAN — or describe the duty and we select the part. We confirm the full ordering code with the quotation.

faqs.question: Can port 3 be used as a work port?
faqs.answer: Not on the versions that drain internally to port 3, because pressure there adds to the setting (or opposes opening) one-for-one. Choose a version with a separate drain at port 4 where port 3 has to carry load pressure.

faqs.question: Are the direct-acting and pilot-operated versions interchangeable?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both fit the same cavity with the same flow path, so one can replace the other. The direct-acting valve leaks less and uses almost no pilot flow; the pilot-operated valve holds its setting more closely.

faqs.question: Does the valve snap fully from one position to the other?
faqs.answer: No. It is not bistable: between the two positions it can sit part-way open and modulate, so it should be applied as a pressure-operated switch with that in mind, not as a detented valve.

faqs.question: Which parts of the cartridge can be serviced?
faqs.answer: Only the external seals. Sun supplies a seal kit for every cartridge, and the kit numbers for this valve are listed under Installation and seal kits. Fitting a different external seal material does not make the valve compatible with a new fluid, because the internal seals stay as built.

A spool directional cartridge moved by hydraulic pilot pressure instead of a solenoid. The 4-way versions are 6-port valves with supply at port 3 and pilot ports X and Y (ports 5 and 6); all ports, pilot ports included, take 5,000 psi (350 bar). A choice of spools sets the flow paths.

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in one version:

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. products.title: Sun Hydraulics 4-Way, 3-Position, Pilot-to-Shift Directional Valve — DCCC to DDHC, Series 1 to 4
products.descriptionShort: Sun Hydraulics 4-Way, 3-Position, Pilot-to-Shift Directional Valve: DCCC to DDHC, series 1 to 4, 7 - 10 gpm to 80 gpm (28 - 40 L/min to 320 L/min), T-61A, T-62A, T-52A, T-63A, T-53A, T-64A and more cavities. Authorised Sun Hydraulics distributor, UAE — supplied direct from Sun.
products.descriptionLong:
A spool directional cartridge moved by hydraulic pilot pressure instead of a solenoid. The 4-way versions are 6-port valves with supply at port 3 and pilot ports X and Y (ports 5 and 6); all ports, pilot ports included, take 5,000 psi (350 bar). A choice of spools sets the flow paths.

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in 7 versions:

  • DCCC — series 1, T-61A cavity, 7 - 10 gpm (28 - 40 L/min)
  • DCDC — series 2, T-62A cavity, 11 - 30 gpm (38 - 120 L/min)
  • DDDC — series 2, T-52A cavity, 20 gpm (80 L/min)
  • DCEC — series 3, T-63A cavity, 25 - 100 gpm (95 - 380 L/min)
  • DDFC — series 3, T-53A cavity, 40 gpm (160 L/min)
  • DCFC — series 4, T-64A cavity, 50 - 200 gpm (200 - 760 L/min)
  • DDHC — series 4, T-54A cavity, 80 gpm (320 L/min)

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series.

Ratings

  • Maximum operating pressure: 5000 psi (350 bar)
  • Minimum pilot pressure to shift: 175 psi (12 bar), 150 psi (10,5 bar), 125 psi (9 bar), 200 psi (14 bar)
  • Maximum leakage: 2 in³/min.@1000 psi (30 cc/min.@70 bar), 10 in³/min.@1000 psi (160 cc/min.@70 bar), 5 in³/min.@1000 psi (80 cc/min.@70 bar)

Configuration options

The letters after the base model code choose these options (shown for DCCC; a size may add or drop a choice):

  • Control: X — Standard Pilot
  • Spool / poppet configuration: A — A to T Center, B — B to T Center, C — Blocked Center, F — Closed Center, A and B to T, H — Open Center, N — P to A and B to T Center, R — Regen Center, T — Tandem Center, W — A and B Bleed to T Center, Y — A and B to T Center, X — P to B and A to T Center
  • Seal material: N — Buna-N, V — Viton
  • Material / coating: /AP — Stainless Steel, Passivated, /LH — Mild Steel, Zinc-Nickel

Option rules: If the modifier is /AP, the control must be X; If the modifier is /LH, the control must be X.

Selection notes

  • Capacity depends on the spool: flow forces can stop a spool reaching full stroke at high flow and pressure, so higher flows are possible at lower pressures.
  • Check the minimum pilot pressure in the ratings against your pilot supply.

Where it is used

Main-stage directional control piloted from a joystick, a remote pilot valve or a small solenoid pilot.

Installation and seal kits

Hex 7/8 in. (22,2 mm), 1 1/8 in. (28,6 mm), 1 1/4 in. (31,8 mm), 1 5/8 in. (41,3 mm); installation torque 30 - 35 lbf ft (41 - 47 Nm), 45 - 50 lbf ft (61 - 68 Nm), 150 - 160 lbf ft (203 - 217 Nm), 350 - 375 lbf ft (474 - 508 Nm). Replacement seal kits — series 1: Buna: 990061007, Polyurethane: 990061002, Viton: 990061006; series 2: Buna: 990062007, Polyurethane: 990062002, Viton: 990062006, Buna: 990052007, Viton: 990052006; series 3: Buna: 990063007, EPDM: 990063014, Polyurethane: 990063002, Viton: 990063006, Buna: 990053007, Viton: 990053006; series 4: Buna: 990064007, EPDM: 990064014, Polyurethane: 990064002, Viton: 990064006, Buna: 990054007, Viton: 990054006.

Ordering

Indus Hydraulics is an authorised Sun Hydraulics distributor in the UAE and supplies the range direct from Sun Hydraulics. Quote the base model and its configuration letters — for example DCCCXCN — or describe the duty and we select the part. We confirm the full ordering code with the quotation.

products.descriptionLong:
A directional cartridge with its own T-8A pilot cavity. When the pilot cartridge screwed into that cavity opens and passes a small flow, the main stage shifts. There must be pressure at port 1, relative to port 3, to move it.

  • Normally closed.
  • The spring chamber drains to a separate port 4, so pressure at port 3 does not shift the setting and port 3 can work as a load port.
  • A T-8A pilot cavity is machined into the end, so a pilot cartridge screws straight in (ordered separately).

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in 2 versions:

  • DVBN — series 1, T-21A cavity, 7 gpm (28 L/min)
  • DVCN — series 2, T-22A cavity, 15 gpm (60 L/min)

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series.

Ratings

  • Maximum operating pressure: 5000 psi (350 bar)
  • Maximum leakage: 2 in³/min.@1000 psi (30 cc/min.@70 bar)
  • Control pilot flow: 7 - 10 in³/min. (0,11 - 0,16 L/min)

Configuration options

The letters after the base model code choose these options (shown for DVBN; a size may add or drop a choice):

  • Control: 8 — T-8A Cavity
  • Setting range: F — 100 psi (7 bar)
  • Seal material: N — Buna-N, V — Viton

Selection notes

  • Pressure at port 3 can oppose opening — use a drain-to-port-4 version where port 3 carries load.
  • It can modulate between positions; it is not a snap-acting switch.

Where it is used

Solenoid or manual switching of moderate flows without a separate pilot body or pilot lines.

products.title: Sun Hydraulics 2-Way, Vent-to-Operate, Directional Valve with Internal Drain to Port 3 and Integral T-8A Control Cavity, Normally Open — DVBA, DVCA
products.focusKeyword: vent-to-operate directional valve with T-8A pilot cavity
products.descriptionShort: Sun Hydraulics 2-Way, Vent-to-Operate, Directional Valve with Internal Drain to Port 3 and Integral T-8A Control Cavity, Normally Open: DVBA, DVCA, series 1 to 2, 7 gpm to 15 gpm (28 L/min to 60 L/min), T-11A, T-2A cavities. Authorised Sun Hydraulics distributor, UAE — supplied direct from Sun.
products.descriptionLong:
A directional cartridge with its own T-8A pilot cavity. When the pilot cartridge screwed into that cavity opens and passes a small flow, the main stage shifts. There must be pressure at port 1, relative to port 3, to move it.

This version

  • Normally open.
  • The spring chamber drains internally to port 3, so pressure at port 3 adds to the setting.
  • A T-8A pilot cavity is machined into the end, so a pilot cartridge screws straight in (ordered separately).

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in 2 versions:

  • DVBA — series 1, T-11A cavity, 7 gpm (28 L/min)
  • DVCA — series 2, T-2A cavity, 15 gpm (60 L/min)

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series.

Ratings

  • Maximum operating pressure: 5000 psi (350 bar)
  • Maximum leakage: 2 in³/min.@1000 psi (30 cc/min.@70 bar)
  • Control pilot flow: 7 - 10 in³/min. (0,11 - 0,16 L/min), 10 - 15 in³/min. (0,16 - 0,25 L/min)

Configuration options

The letters after the base model code choose these options (shown for DVBA; a size may add or drop a choice):

  • Control: 8 — T-8A Cavity
  • Setting range: F — 100 psi (7 bar)
  • Seal material: N — Buna-N, V — Viton

Selection notes

  • Pressure at port 3 can oppose opening — use a drain-to-port-4 version where port 3 carries load.
  • It can modulate between positions; it is not a snap-acting switch.

Where it is used

Solenoid or manual switching of moderate flows without a separate pilot body or pilot lines.

Installation and seal kits

Hex 7/8 in. (22,2 mm), 1 1/8 in. (28,6 mm); installation torque 30 - 35 lbf ft (41 - 47 Nm), 45 - 50 lbf ft (61 - 68 Nm). Replacement seal kits — series 1: Buna: 990011007, Polyurethane: 990011002, Viton: 990011006; series 2: Buna: 990202007, Polyurethane: 990002002, Viton: 990202006.

Ordering

Indus Hydraulics is an authorised Sun Hydraulics distributor in the UAE and supplies the range direct from Sun Hydraulics. Quote the base model and its configuration letters — for example DVBA8FN — or describe the duty and we select the part. We confirm the full ordering code with the quotation.

products.descriptionShort: Sun Hydraulics 3-Way, Vent-to-Operate, Directional Valve with Internal Drain to Port 3 and Integral T-8A Control Cavity (1 to 2 Open, 3 Blocked): DVBD, DVCD, series 1 to 2, 7 gpm to 15 gpm (28 L/min to 60 L/min), T-11A, T-2A cavities. Authorised Sun Hydraulics distributor, UAE — supplied direct from Sun.
products.descriptionLong:
A directional cartridge with its own T-8A pilot cavity. When the pilot cartridge screwed into that cavity opens and passes a small flow, the main stage shifts. There must be pressure at port 1, relative to port 3, to move it.

This version

  • At rest: 1 to 2 open; 3 blocked.
  • The spring chamber drains internally to port 3, so pressure at port 3 adds to the setting.
  • A T-8A pilot cavity is machined into the end, so a pilot cartridge screws straight in (ordered separately).

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in 2 versions:

  • DVBD — series 1, T-11A cavity, 7 gpm (28 L/min)
  • DVCD — series 2, T-2A cavity, 15 gpm (60 L/min)

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series.

Ratings

  • Maximum operating pressure: 5000 psi (350 bar)
  • Maximum leakage: 2 in³/min.@1000 psi (30 cc/min.@70 bar)
  • Control pilot flow: 7 - 10 in³/min. (0,11 - 0,16 L/min), 10 - 15 in³/min. (0,16 - 0,25 L/min)

Configuration options

The letters after the base model code choose these options (shown for DVBD; a size may add or drop a choice):

  • Control: 8 — T-8A Cavity
  • Setting range: F — 100 psi (7 bar)
  • Seal material: N — Buna-N, V — Viton

Selection notes

  • Pressure at port 3 can oppose opening — use a drain-to-port-4 version where port 3 carries load.
  • It can modulate between positions; it is not a snap-acting switch.

Where it is used

Solenoid or manual switching of moderate flows without a separate pilot body or pilot lines.

Installation and seal kits

Hex 7/8 in. (22,2 mm), 1 1/8 in. (28,6 mm); installation torque 30 - 35 lbf ft (41 - 47 Nm), 45 - 50 lbf ft (61 - 68 Nm). Replacement seal kits — series 1: Buna: 990011007, Polyurethane: 990011002, Viton: 990011006; series 2: Buna: 990202007, Polyurethane: 990002002, Viton: 990202006.

faqs.question: What goes in the T-8A cavity?
faqs.answer: A pilot cartridge, ordered separately: a solenoid, manual, air-operated or hydraulically operated pilot valve, or a pressure-control pilot. Torque the main stage into the manifold first, then the pilot into the main stage.

faqs.question: Can port 3 be used as a work port?
faqs.answer: Not on the versions that drain internally to port 3, because pressure there adds to the setting (or opposes opening) one-for-one. Choose a version with a separate drain at port 4 where port 3 has to carry load pressure.

products.descriptionShort: Sun Hydraulics 120:1 Ratio Pilot-to-Close Check Valve: COFO, series 2, 1 gpm (.05 inch) (4 L/min. (1,3 mm)), T-2A cavity. Authorised Sun Hydraulics distributor, UAE — supplied direct from Sun.
products.descriptionLong:
A spring-closed check that passes oil from port 1 to port 2 and blocks the reverse. Pressure at the pilot port (port 3) acts against port 1 and holds it shut, so it can be closed on command even in its free-flow direction. Pressure at port 2 opposes the pilot directly.

This version

  • Built to discharge an accumulator when the pump stops: with no pump pressure at port 3 it opens the accumulator (port 1) to tank (port 2), and a pump pressure of only 60 psi (4 bar) on port 3 shuts it against up to 5,000 psi. Discharge is through a 0.05 in (1.27 mm) orifice, so very large accumulators may need a two-valve circuit.

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in one version:

  • COFO — series 2, T-2A cavity, 1 gpm (.05 inch) (4 L/min. (1,3 mm))

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series.

Ratings

  • Maximum operating pressure: 5000 psi (350 bar)
  • Maximum leakage: 5 drops/min. (0,3 cc/min)

Configuration options

The letters after the base model code choose these options (shown for COFO; a size may add or drop a choice):

  • Control: X — Standard Pilot
  • Setting range: D — 60 psi (4 bar)
  • Seal material: N — Buna-N, V — Viton

Selection notes

  • Hardened steel seats for wear resistance and dirt tolerance.
  • Any drop in pilot pressure, even a momentary one, can let the valve open.

Accumulator discharge on shut-down, blocking a flow path while a function is pressurised, logic-style switching in pilot circuits.

faqs.question: What does the pilot ratio mean on a pilot-to-close check?
faqs.answer: It compares the pilot area with the port 1 area. At 1.8:1, 1,000 psi on the pilot keeps the valve shut against 1,800 psi at port 1; higher ratios close it against much higher inlet pressures with a small pilot.

faqs.question: How tight is the check when it is closed?
faqs.answer: Very tight: the published maximum is under one drop a minute. If a load starts to drift through a check that used to hold, the seat has usually been marked by dirt and the cartridge should be replaced.

faqs.question: How much pilot pressure opens a pilot-to-open check?
faqs.answer: It depends on the load. The pilot has to overcome the load pressure at port 1 divided by the pilot ratio, plus the spring, and any pressure at port 2 adds to what is needed. A 3:1 valve holding 3,000 psi needs roughly 1,000 psi on the pilot.

faqs.question: Pilot-to-open check or counterbalance valve?
faqs.answer: A pilot-to-open check is an on/off lock: it holds the load and opens fully when piloted, so it suits loads that are driven both ways. An overrunning load being lowered needs a counterbalance valve, which meters the flow out and stops the load running away.

faqs.question: How much pilot pressure opens a pilot-to-open check?
faqs.answer: It depends on the load. The pilot has to overcome the load pressure at port 1 divided by the pilot ratio, plus the spring, and any pressure at port 2 adds to what is needed. A 3:1 valve holding 3,000 psi needs roughly 1,000 psi on the pilot.

faqs.question: Pilot-to-open check or counterbalance valve?
faqs.answer: A pilot-to-open check is an on/off lock: it holds the load and opens fully when piloted, so it suits loads that are driven both ways. An overrunning load being lowered needs a counterbalance valve, which meters the flow out and stops the load running away.

faqs.question: How tight is the check when it is closed?
faqs.answer: Very tight: the published maximum is under one drop a minute. If a load starts to drift through a check that used to hold, the seat has usually been marked by dirt and the cartridge should be replaced.

products.descriptionLong:
A pilot-to-open check lets oil flow freely from the valve side (port 2) into the actuator (port 1) and locks it there. Pressure at the pilot port (port 3) lifts the poppet so the actuator can return. The pilot pressure needed rises with the load pressure, and pressure at port 2 works against the pilot.

This version

  • Standard (unsealed) pilot, which lets air trapped in the pilot line purge itself.

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in 5 versions:

  • CKBB — series 0, T-163A cavity, 7.5 gpm (30 L/min)
  • CKCB — series 1, T-11A cavity, 15 gpm (60 L/min)
  • CKEB — series 2, T-2A cavity, 30 gpm (120 L/min)
  • CKGB — series 3, T-17A cavity, 60 gpm (240 L/min)
  • CKIB — series 4, T-19A cavity, 120 gpm (480 L/min)

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series.

Ratings

  • Pilot ratio: 3:1
  • Maximum operating pressure: 5000 psi (350 bar)
  • Maximum leakage: 1 drops/min. (0,07 cc/min)

Configuration options

The letters after the base model code choose these options (shown for CKCB; a size may add or drop a choice):

  • Control: X — Standard Pilot, L — Manual Load Release, B — External 1/4 BSPP Pilot Port, Port 3 blocked, C — Manual Load Release - Tamper Resistant, D — Manual Load Release, E — External 4-SAE Pilot Port, Port 3 Blocked, G — Slow Acting Pilot, P — External 1/4 NPTF Pilot Port, Port 3 Blocked
  • Check cracking pressure: C — 30 psi (2 bar), A — 4 psi (0,3 bar), B — 15 psi (1 bar), D — 50 psi (3,5 bar), E — 75 psi (5 bar), F — 100 psi (7 bar), G — 150 psi (10,5 bar), Z — 1 psi (0,07 bar)
  • Seal material: N — Buna-N, L — Extended Temp. Buna, V — Viton, E — EPDM

faqs.question: How much pilot pressure opens a pilot-to-open check?
faqs.answer: It depends on the load. The pilot has to overcome the load pressure at port 1 divided by the pilot ratio, plus the spring, and any pressure at port 2 adds to what is needed. A 3:1 valve holding 3,000 psi needs roughly 1,000 psi on the pilot.

faqs.question: Pilot-to-open check or counterbalance valve?
faqs.answer: A pilot-to-open check is an on/off lock: it holds the load and opens fully when piloted, so it suits loads that are driven both ways. An overrunning load being lowered needs a counterbalance valve, which meters the flow out and stops the load running away.

faqs.question: How tight is the check when it is closed?
faqs.answer: Very tight: the published maximum is under one drop a minute. If a load starts to drift through a check that used to hold, the seat has usually been marked by dirt and the cartridge should be replaced.

products.descriptionLong:
Two checks back to back in one cartridge, connecting the higher of two work ports to a common signal port. Hardened, lapped, guided poppets on a lightly stressed spring give very low leakage and long life.

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in one version:

  • CDAB — series 1, T-11A cavity, 2.5 gpm (10 L/min)

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series.

Ratings

  • Maximum operating pressure: 5000 psi (350 bar)
  • Maximum leakage: 5 drops/min. (0,3 cc/min)

Configuration options

The letters after the base model code choose these options (shown for CDAB; a size may add or drop a choice):

  • Control: A — Auxiliary External -4 SAE Port, B — Auxiliary External 1/4 BSPP Port, X — Not Adjustable, E — External 4-SAE Port, Port 3 blocked
  • Check cracking pressure: B — 15 psi (1 bar)
  • Seal material: N — Buna-N, V — Viton
  • Material / coating: /AP — Stainless Steel, Passivated, /LH — Mild Steel, Zinc-Nickel

Option rules: If the modifier is /AP, the control must be X; If the modifier is /LH, the control must be X.

Selection notes

  • It holds the highest pressure it has seen: if the load ports fall, the signal stays trapped, so the circuit needs a way to bleed it.
  • Floating construction keeps the poppets free if the cartridge is over-torqued.

Load-sensing and pilot circuits where the signal must not leak away between strokes.

products.descriptionLong:
A ball shuttle connects whichever of two work ports is at the higher pressure to a common signal port and seals off the lower one. Hardened balls and seats tolerate dirt and wear well.

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in 2 versions:

  • CSAX — series 0, T-163A cavity, 1.25 gpm (4,7 L/min)
  • CSAB — series 1, T-11A cavity, 2.5 gpm (10 L/min)

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series.

Ratings

  • Maximum operating pressure: 5000 psi (350 bar)
  • Maximum leakage: 5 drops/min. (0,3 cc/min)

Configuration options

The letters after the base model code choose these options (shown for CSAB; a size may add or drop a choice):

  • Control: A — Auxiliary External -4 SAE Port, B — Auxiliary External 1/4 BSPP Port, X — Not Adjustable, E — External 4-SAE Port, Port 3 blocked
  • Seal material: L — Extended Temp. Buna, N — Buna-N, V — Viton, E — EPDM
  • Material / coating: /AP — Stainless Steel, Passivated, /LH — Mild Steel, Zinc-Nickel

Option rules: EPDM seals are not allowed on modifier /AP or /LH; If the modifier is /AP, the control must be X; If the modifier is /LH, the control must be X; If the seal is E, the control must be X; If the seal is L, the control must be X.

Selection notes

  • When both work ports fall, the ball lets the signal fall with them.
  • Floating construction keeps the ball and seats aligned if the cartridge is over-torqued.

Where it is used

Load-sensing signal networks, brake release taken from either motor port, picking the higher of two pressures for a gauge or pilot.

Installation and seal kits

Hex 3/4 in. (19,1 mm), 7/8 in. (22,2 mm); installation torque 20 - 25 lbf ft (27 - 33 Nm), 30 - 35 lbf ft (41 - 47 Nm). Replacement seal kits — series 0: Buna: 990163007, Polyurethane: 990163002, Viton: 990163006; series 1: Buna: 990011007, EPDM: 990011014, Polyurethane: 990011002, Viton: 990011006.

products.descriptionLong:
A spool shuttle for closed-loop hydrostatic drives. With both loop sides equal it centres with all ports blocked; when one side rises, it connects the opposite, low-pressure side to the common port (port 3) so hot oil can be bled out through a relief and replaced by cool charge oil.

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in one version:

  • DSCL — series 1, T-31A cavity, 15 gpm (60 L/min)

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series.

Ratings

  • Maximum operating pressure: 5000 psi (350 bar)
  • Maximum leakage: 1 in³/min.@1000 psi (15 cc/min.@70 bar)

Configuration options

The letters after the base model code choose these options (shown for DSCL; a size may add or drop a choice):

  • Control: X — Not Adjustable
  • Setting range: C — 30 psi (2 bar), E — 75 psi (5 bar), F — 100 psi (7 bar), G — 150 psi (10,5 bar)
  • Seal material: N — Buna-N, V — Viton
  • Material / coating: /LH — Mild Steel, Zinc-Nickel

Option rules: If the modifier is /LH, the control must be X.

Selection notes

  • A hydraulic stop ends the spool's travel without metal-to-metal impact; it costs a small pilot flow from the high side to port 3.
  • Because of that stop, the hot-oil relief setting can be checked with the drive in neutral.
  • Too low a shift pressure can let charge pressure alone shift the valve — choose the shift range with care.

Where it is used

Hydrostatic transmissions on mobile machines, winch and swing drives — loop flushing.

faqs.answer: It stays centred until one side has really become the low side, then opens gradually after about two seconds, so flow transients do not reach the circuit downstream of the hot-oil relief.

faqs.question: What is a logic element?
faqs.answer: A two-port poppet cartridge that opens or closes according to the force balance between its two work ports, the spring and the pilot (control) port. A small pilot valve on the control port lets it switch large flows.

faqs.question: Balanced or unbalanced logic element?
faqs.answer: A balanced element switches predictably whatever the pressures at ports 1 and 2, because those pressures do not act on the poppet's opening force. An unbalanced element responds to the pressure at every port, so it can act as a check, a relief or a switch, but every operating condition has to be checked against its area ratios. Both use the same cavity in a given frame size.

products.descriptionShort: Sun Hydraulics Normally Closed, Balanced Poppet, Logic Element, Pressure Adjustable: DKDP, DKFP, DKHP, DKJP, series 1 to 4, 15 gpm to 120 gpm (60 L/min to 480 L/min), T-21A, T-22A, T-23A, T-24A cavities. Authorised Sun Hydraulics distributor, UAE — supplied direct from Sun.
products.descriptionLong:
A normally closed 2-way logic element with a balanced poppet: pressure at ports 1 and 2 does not push it open, so it switches predictably on its control signal alone, with 5,000 psi (350 bar) at both work ports.

This version

  • Normally closed.
  • Pressure-adjustable control: the element opens at an adjustable pressure, like a relief main stage.

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in 4 versions:

  • DKDP — series 1, T-21A cavity, 15 gpm (60 L/min)
  • DKFP — series 2, T-22A cavity, 30 gpm (120 L/min)
  • DKHP — series 3, T-23A cavity, 60 gpm (240 L/min)
  • DKJP — series 4, T-24A cavity, 120 gpm (480 L/min)

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series.

Ratings

  • Maximum operating pressure: 5000 psi (350 bar)
  • Minimum pilot pressure to shift: 400 psi (28 bar), 300 psi (20 bar)
  • Maximum leakage: 10 drops/min.@5000 psi (0,7 cc/min.@350 bar)

Configuration options

The letters after the base model code choose these options (shown for DKDP; a size may add or drop a choice):

  • Control: C — Tamper Resistant - Factory Set, K — Handknob, L — Standard Screw Adjustment
  • Setting range: A — 400 - 3000 psi (28 - 210 bar), 1000 psi (70 bar) Standard Setting, B — 400 - 1500 psi (28 - 105 bar), 1000 psi (70 bar) Standard Setting, W — 400 - 4500 psi (28 - 315 bar), 1000 psi (70 bar) Standard Setting, C — 400 - 6000 psi (28 - 420 bar), 1000 psi (70 bar) Standard Setting, D — 400 - 800 psi (28 - 55 bar), 400 psi (28 bar) Standard Setting
  • Seal material: N — Buna-N, V — Viton, E — EPDM
  • Material / coating: /AP — Stainless Steel, Passivated, /LH — Mild Steel, Zinc-Nickel

Option rules: If the modifier is /AP, the control must be C or L; If the modifier is /LH, the control must be C or L; If the seal is E, the control must be C,K or L.

Selection notes

  • Needs a minimum pilot pressure (about 400 psi, 30 bar, on series 1) with the external drain open.
  • Same cavity as an unbalanced logic element of the same frame size, so it can replace one.
  • X control vents to atmosphere (a fix for existing circuits that may weep over time); E control uses a static external drain, the better choice for new designs.

Where it is used

High-flow on/off switching and isolation in presses, test rigs and mobile valve blocks.

Installation and seal kits

Hex 7/8 in. (22,2 mm), 1 1/8 in. (28,6 mm), 1 1/4 in. (31,8 mm), 1 5/8 in. (41,3 mm); installation torque 30 - 35 lbf ft (41 - 47 Nm), 45 - 50 lbf ft (61 - 68 Nm), 150 - 160 lbf ft (203 - 217 Nm), 350 - 375 lbf ft (474 - 508 Nm). Replacement seal kits — series 1: Buna: 990021007, Polyurethane: 990021002, Viton: 990021006; series 2: Buna: 990022007, Polyurethane: 990022002, Viton: 990022006; series 3: Buna: 990023007, Polyurethane: 990023002, Viton: 990023006; series 4: Buna: 990024007, Polyurethane: 990024002, Viton: 990024006.

Ordering

Indus Hydraulics is an authorised Sun Hydraulics distributor in the UAE and supplies the range direct from Sun Hydraulics. Quote the base model and its configuration letters — for example DKDPLAN — or describe the duty and we select the part. We confirm the full ordering code with the quotation.

faqs.question: What is a logic element?
faqs.answer: A two-port poppet cartridge that opens or closes according to the force balance between its two work ports, the spring and the pilot (control) port. A small pilot valve on the control port lets it switch large flows.

faqs.question: Balanced or unbalanced logic element?
faqs.answer: A balanced element switches predictably whatever the pressures at ports 1 and 2, because those pressures do not act on the poppet's opening force. An unbalanced element responds to the pressure at every port, so it can act as a check, a relief or a switch, but every operating condition has to be checked against its area ratios. Both use the same cavity in a given frame size.

faqs.question: What does the full Sun model code mean?
faqs.answer: The four letters are the base model: valve type, frame size and variant. The letters that follow choose the control, setting range, seal material and any material or coating option. We confirm the full code, for example DKDPLAN, with the quotation.

faqs.question: How do I order or get a quotation?
faqs.answer: Send us the Sun model code — from the valve itself or the machine drawing — with the quantity, or describe the duty if you are choosing a new valve. We confirm the full ordering code, price and delivery with the quotation. Indus Hydraulics is an authorised Sun Hydraulics distributor in the UAE.

faqs.question: Which parts of the cartridge can be serviced?
faqs.answer: Only the external seals. Sun supplies a seal kit for every cartridge, and the kit numbers for this valve are listed under Installation and seal kits. Fitting a different external seal material does not make the valve compatible with a new fluid, because the internal seals stay as built.

faqs.question: How is the cartridge installed?
faqs.answer: It screws into a cavity machined to Sun's drawing for its series, and is tightened to the installation torque given in the specifications. Main stages with an integral T-8A pilot cavity go in first, and the pilot cartridge is then fitted into them to its own torque.

products.descriptionLong:

  • Normally open.

  • DOHP — series 3, T-23A cavity, 60 gpm (240 L/min)
  • DOJP — series 4, T-24A cavity, 120 gpm (480 L/min)

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series.

  • Maximum operating pressure: 5000 psi (350 bar)

Where it is used

High-flow switching where the path must stay open with no signal — bypass, unloading and dump functions.

Installation and seal kits

Hex 7/8 in. (22,2 mm), 1 1/8 in. (28,6 mm), 1 1/4 in. (31,8 mm), 1 5/8 in. products.title: Sun Hydraulics Pilot-to-Close, Spring-Biased Closed, Unbalanced Poppet Logic Element — LODC to LOKC, Series 1 to 4
products.descriptionShort: Sun Hydraulics Pilot-to-Close, Spring-Biased Closed, Unbalanced Poppet Logic Element: LODC to LOKC, series 1 to 4, 25 gpm to 300 gpm (95 L/min to 1100 L/min), T-11A, T-2A, T-17A, T-19A, T-19AU cavities. Authorised Sun Hydraulics distributor, UAE — supplied direct from Sun.
products.descriptionLong:
An unbalanced poppet logic element. Pressure at either work port pushes it open; pressure at the pilot port (port 3) plus the spring holds it shut. It stays closed only while the pilot and spring force exceed the forces at ports 1 and 2.

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in 6 versions:

  • LODC — series 1, T-11A cavity, 25 gpm (95 L/min)
  • LOFC — series 2, T-2A cavity, 50 gpm (200 L/min)
  • LOHC — series 3, T-17A cavity, 100 gpm (380 L/min)
  • LOHCL — series 3, T-17A cavity, 100 gpm (380 L/min)
  • LOJC — series 4, T-19A cavity, 200 gpm (760 L/min)
  • LOKC — series 4, T-19AU cavity, 300 gpm (1100 L/min)

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series.

Ratings

  • Maximum operating pressure: 5000 psi (350 bar)
  • Pilot area ratios (pilot to port 1 / port 2): 1.8:1 / 2.25:1
  • Maximum leakage: 10 drops/min. (0,7 cc/min)

Configuration options

The letters after the base model code choose these options (shown for LODC; a size may add or drop a choice):

  • Control: X — Not Adjustable, E — External 4-SAE Pilot Port, Port 3 Blocked, K — Handknob, L — Stroke Adjustment
  • Check cracking pressure: D — 50 psi (3,5 bar)
  • Seal material: N — Buna-N, V — Viton
  • Material / coating: /AP — Stainless Steel, Passivated, /LH — Mild Steel, Zinc-Nickel

Option rules: If the modifier is /AP, the control must be X; If the modifier is /LH, the control must be L or X.

Selection notes

  • A positive seal separates port 2 from the pilot area.
  • Because it responds to pressure at every port, check every stage of the machine cycle against the area ratios.

Where it is used

High-flow check, unloading and switching functions built from one cavity and a small pilot valve.

Installation and seal kits

Hex 7/8 in. (22,2 mm), 1 1/8 in. (28,6 mm), 1 1/4 in. (31,8 mm), 1 5/8 in. (41,3 mm); installation torque 30 - 35 lbf ft (41 - 47 Nm), 45 - 50 lbf ft (61 - 68 Nm), 150 - 160 lbf ft (203 - 217 Nm), 350 - 375 lbf ft (474 - 508 Nm). Replacement seal kits — series 1: Buna: 990011007, Polyurethane: 990011002, Viton: 990011006; series 2: Buna: 990202007, Polyurethane: 990002002, Viton: 990202006; series 3: Buna: 990017007, EPDM: 990017014, Polyurethane: 990017002, Viton: 990017006; series 4: Buna: 990019007, Polyurethane: 990019002, Viton: 990019006, EPDM: 990019014.

faqs.question: What are the area ratios?
faqs.answer: Port 1 acts on 100% of the poppet area, port 2 on 80% and the pilot (port 3) on 180%. So the pilot area is 1.8 times port 1 and 2.25 times port 2; compare the forces at each port to see whether the valve opens or stays shut.

faqs.question: Balanced or unbalanced logic element?
faqs.answer: A balanced element switches predictably whatever the pressures at ports 1 and 2, because those pressures do not act on the poppet's opening force. An unbalanced element responds to the pressure at every port, so it can act as a check, a relief or a switch, but every operating condition has to be checked against its area ratios. Both use the same cavity in a given frame size.

faqs.question: What is a logic element?
faqs.answer: A two-port poppet cartridge that opens or closes according to the force balance between its two work ports, the spring and the pilot (control) port. A small pilot valve on the control port lets it switch large flows.

faqs.question: What does the full Sun model code mean?
faqs.answer: The four letters are the base model: valve type, frame size and variant. The letters that follow choose the control, setting range, seal material and any material or coating option. We confirm the full code, for example LODCXDN, with the quotation.

faqs.question: How do I order or get a quotation?
faqs.answer: Send us the Sun model code — from the valve itself or the machine drawing — with the quantity, or describe the duty if you are choosing a new valve. We confirm the full ordering code, price and delivery with the quotation. Indus Hydraulics is an authorised Sun Hydraulics distributor in the UAE.

faqs.question: Which parts of the cartridge can be serviced?
faqs.answer: Only the external seals. Sun supplies a seal kit for every cartridge, and the kit numbers for this valve are listed under Installation and seal kits. Fitting a different external seal material does not make the valve compatible with a new fluid, because the internal seals stay as built.

products.descriptionLong:
A spring-closed, unbalanced poppet logic element that takes its pilot oil from its own work port through an internal orifice. With the control port blocked it stays shut in one direction and acts as a check in the other; vent the control port and it opens, provided there is pressure to overcome the spring.

This version

  • Pilot oil is taken from port 1; from port 2 to port 1 it acts as a check while the control port is blocked.

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in 5 versions:

  • LODA — series 1, T-11A cavity, 25 gpm (95 L/min)
  • LOFA — series 2, T-2A cavity, 50 gpm (200 L/min)
  • LOHA — series 3, T-17A cavity, 100 gpm (380 L/min)
  • LOJA — series 4, T-19A cavity, 200 gpm (760 L/min)
  • LOKA — series 4, T-19AU cavity, 300 gpm (1100 L/min)

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series.

Ratings

  • Maximum operating pressure: 5000 psi (350 bar)
  • Pilot area ratios (pilot to port 1 / port 2): 1.8:1 / 2.25:1
  • Maximum leakage: 10 drops/min. (0,7 cc/min)

Configuration options

The letters after the base model code choose these options (shown for LODA; a size may add or drop a choice):

  • Control: X — Not Adjustable, E — External 4-SAE Port, Port 3 blocked, L — Stroke Adjustment
  • Check cracking pressure: D — 50 psi (3,5 bar)
  • Seal material: N — Buna-N, V — Viton
  • Material / coating: /AP — Stainless Steel, Passivated

Option rules: If the modifier is /AP, the control must be L or X.

Selection notes

  • It opens quickly when vented; closing time depends on flow and pressure drop and is hard to predict.
  • Pilot-source options: port 1, port 2, or either through an internal shuttle.

Where it is used

High-flow on/off functions vented by a small 2-way pilot valve — no separate pilot supply needed.

Authorised Sun Hydraulics distributor, UAE — supplied direct from Sun.
products.descriptionLong:
A spring-closed, unbalanced poppet logic element that takes its pilot oil from its own work port through an internal orifice. With the control port blocked it stays shut in one direction and acts as a check in the other; vent the control port and it opens, provided there is pressure to overcome the spring.

This version

  • Pilot oil is taken from port 2.

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in 5 versions:

  • LODB — series 1, T-11A cavity, 25 gpm (95 L/min)
  • LOFB — series 2, T-2A cavity, 50 gpm (200 L/min)
  • LOHB — series 3, T-17A cavity, 100 gpm (380 L/min)
  • LOJB — series 4, T-19A cavity, 200 gpm (760 L/min)
  • LOKB — series 4, T-19AU cavity, 300 gpm (1100 L/min)

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series.

Ratings

  • Maximum operating pressure: 5000 psi (350 bar)
  • Pilot area ratios (pilot to port 1 / port 2): 1.8:1 / 2.25:1
  • Maximum leakage: 10 drops/min. (0,7 cc/min)

Configuration options

The letters after the base model code choose these options (shown for LODB; a size may add or drop a choice):

  • Control: X — Not Adjustable, L — Stroke Adjustment
  • Check cracking pressure: D — 50 psi (3,5 bar)
  • Seal material: N — Buna-N, V — Viton
  • Material / coating: /AP — Stainless Steel, Passivated

Option rules: If the modifier is /AP, the control must be L or X.

Selection notes

  • It opens quickly when vented; closing time depends on flow and pressure drop and is hard to predict.
  • Pilot-source options: port 1, port 2, or either through an internal shuttle.
  • A positive seal separates port 2 from the pilot area.

Where it is used

High-flow on/off functions vented by a small 2-way pilot valve — no separate pilot supply needed.

Installation and seal kits

Hex 7/8 in. (22,2 mm), 1 1/8 in. (28,6 mm), 1 1/4 in. (31,8 mm), 1 5/8 in. (41,3 mm); installation torque 30 - 35 lbf ft (41 - 47 Nm), 45 - 50 lbf ft (61 - 68 Nm), 150 - 160 lbf ft (203 - 217 Nm), 350 - 375 lbf ft (474 - 508 Nm). Replacement seal kits — series 1: Buna: 990011007, Polyurethane: 990011002, Viton: 990011006; series 2: Buna: 990202007, Polyurethane: 990002002, Viton: 990202006; series 3: Buna: 990017007, EPDM: 990017014, Polyurethane: 990017002, Viton: 990017006; series 4: Buna: 990019007, Polyurethane: 990019002, Viton: 990019006.

products.descriptionLong:
A 3-position, 4-way spool valve whose opening follows pilot pressure. In centre the supply (port 3) is closed and the work ports drain to port 5; pilot pressure at port 1 meters supply to port 4 in proportion, and pilot at port 6 meters it to port 2. Flow forces give it some self-compensation as load pressure changes.

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in 5 versions:

  • FTCC — series 2, T-52A cavity, 7 gpm (28 L/min)
  • FTDC — series 2, T-52A cavity, 18 gpm (70 L/min)
  • FTEC — series 3, T-53A cavity, 12 gpm (45 L/min)
  • FTFC — series 3, T-53A cavity, 35 gpm (140 L/min)
  • FTHC — series 4, T-54A cavity, 80 gpm (320 L/min)

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series.

Ratings

  • Maximum operating pressure: 5000 psi (350 bar)
  • Pilot pressure for full shift at rated flow: 290 - 340 psi (20 - 23 bar)
  • Maximum leakage: 5.5 in³/min.@1000 psi (90 cc/min.@70 bar), 2.7 in³/min.@500 psi (44 cc/min.@35 bar), 8 in³/min.@1000 psi (131 cc/min.@70 bar), 14 in³/min.@1000 psi (229 cc/min.@70 bar)

Configuration options

The letters after the base model code choose these options (shown for FTHC; a size may add or drop a choice):

  • Control: X — Not Adjustable
  • Spool / poppet configuration: W — A and B Bleed to T Center, Y — A and B to T Center
  • Seal material: N — Buna-N, V — Viton
  • Material / coating: /AP — Stainless Steel, Passivated

Option rules: If the modifier is /AP, the control must be X.

Selection notes

  • Pilot ports take 5,000 psi (350 bar), but above about 500 psi (35 bar) the spool is fully shifted and flow does not rise.
  • For tighter flow regulation add a separate compensator; Sun shows a bypass compensator for it.

Where it is used

Smooth, proportional motion on mobile functions piloted from hydraulic joysticks or proportional pilot reducing valves.

Installation and seal kits

Hex 1 1/8 in. (28,6 mm), 1 1/4 in. (31,8 mm), 1 5/8 in. (41,3 mm); installation torque 45 - 50 lbf ft (61 - 68 Nm), 150 - 160 lbf ft (203 - 217 Nm), 350 - 375 lbf ft (474 - 508 Nm). Replacement seal kits — series 2: Buna: 990052007, Viton: 990052006; series 3: Buna: 990053007, Viton: 990053006; series 4: Buna: 990054007, Polyurethane: 990054002, Viton: 990054006.

products.descriptionLong:
A spring-centred, 3-position, 4-way spool valve with a proportional solenoid at each end. Current on one coil opens P to B and A to T in proportion; current on the other opens P to A and B to T. It is direct acting, so it needs no minimum hydraulic pressure.

This version

  • At rest: 250 bar.
  • Fits an industry-standard common cavity (SC-08 / SC-10 type) rather than a Sun T-series cavity.
  • Rated to 3600 psi (250 bar).

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in one version:

  • FNUC — series 1C, SC-10-04 cavity, 10 gpm (40 L/min), Common cavity

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series. Series 0C and 1C parts fit industry-standard common cavities (SC-08, SC-10) instead of Sun's T-series cavities.

Ratings

  • Maximum operating pressure: 3600 psi (250 bar)
  • Typical response time: 50 ms

Configuration options

The letters after the base model code choose these options (shown for FNUC; a size may add or drop a choice):

  • Control: T — Lever (Momentary) Manual Override, X — No Manual Override
  • Setting range: A — 1.3 gpm Blocked Center (4,8 L/min.), C — 4 gpm Blocked Center (15 L/min.), E — 8 gpm Blocked Center (30 L/min.), V — 1.3 gpm A and B Bleed to Center (4,8 L/min.), X — 4 gpm A and B Bleed to Center (15 L/min.), Z — 8 gpm A and B Bleed to Center (30 L/min.)
  • Seal material: N — Buna-N
  • Coil: 4 coil choices, or no coil — 12 VDC, 24 VDC; connections include DIN 43650-Form A, Deutsch DT04-2P

Selection notes

  • The tank port is limited to 1,000 psi (70 bar); the other ports to 3,600 psi (250 bar).
  • Blocked centre or A and B bleed-to-tank centre, each in three flow ranges.
  • Fits a common SC-10-04 cavity, not a Sun T-series cavity.

Where it is used

Proportional speed and direction control of small cylinders and motors from an electronic controller.

Installation and seal kits

faqs.answer: The coil is chosen with its own code — voltage and connector — and can be supplied fitted or ordered separately. Tell us the voltage (12 or 24 VDC, or AC) and the connector your machine uses, and we confirm the coil with the quotation.

faqs.question: Does the valve run hot if the coil stays energised?
faqs.answer: The armature runs wet, surrounded by the working fluid, and that fluid picks up heat from the coil. On long duty cycles check the fluid's temperature limit; some fluids, water-glycol in particular, degrade faster when held hot.

faqs.question: Is a manual override available?

If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series. Series 0C and 1C parts fit industry-standard common cavities (SC-08, SC-10) instead of Sun's T-series cavities.

products.descriptionLong:
A direct-acting, balanced-spool 4-way valve — the cartridge equivalent of a small directional valve. Two-position versions have one coil and a choice of spools; three-position versions have a coil at each end and centre on springs. No minimum pressure is needed to shift.

This version

  • At rest: 250 bar.
  • Fits an industry-standard common cavity (SC-08 / SC-10 type) rather than a Sun T-series cavity.
  • Rated to 3600 psi (250 bar).

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in one version:

  • DNUC — series 1C, SC-10-04 cavity, 7 gpm (28 L/min), Common cavity

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series. Series 0C and 1C parts fit industry-standard common cavities (SC-08, SC-10) instead of Sun's T-series cavities.

Ratings

  • Maximum operating pressure: 3600 psi (250 bar)
  • Typical response time: 50 ms
  • Switching frequency: 15,000 max. cycles/hr

Configuration options

products.descriptionLong:
A pilot valve that watches accumulator pressure at port 2. When it reaches the setting, the valve connects port 3 to port 4, venting a relief valve so the pump unloads. When accumulator pressure falls by the valve's differential, it closes again and the pump recharges the accumulator.

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in 4 versions:

  • QPAC — series 1, T-11A cavity, 46 in³/min. (0,75 L/min), 30% reset differential
  • QPAD — series 1, T-11A cavity, 46 in³/min. (0,75 L/min), 50% reset differential

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series.

Ratings

  • Maximum operating pressure: 5000 psi (350 bar)

Configuration options

The letters after the base model code choose these options (shown for QPAD; a size may add or drop a choice):

  • Control: C — Tamper Resistant - Factory Set, L — Standard Screw Adjustment, K — Handknob
  • Setting range: A — 1000 - 3000 psi (70 - 210 bar), 1000 psi (70 bar) Standard Setting, B — 500 - 1500 psi (35 - 105 bar), 500 psi (35 bar) Standard Setting, C — 2000 - 5000 psi (140 - 350 bar), 2000 psi (140 bar) Standard Setting, D — 250 - 800 psi (18 - 55 bar), 250 psi (18 bar) Standard Setting
  • Seal material: N — Buna-N, V — Viton

Selection notes

  • The unload-to-reload differential is held within +3/−2% of its stated ratio.
  • The sensing area is positively sealed.
  • Versions with an integral check suit pumps up to 15 gpm (60 L/min); for bigger pumps use the version without check and a separate check cartridge.

Accumulator charging circuits on presses, braking systems and power units with a fixed pump.

products.descriptionShort: Sun Hydraulics Air Bleed and Start-Up Valve: NQEB, series 2, 4 - 50 gpm (15 - 200 L/min), T-3A cavity. Authorised Sun Hydraulics distributor, UAE — supplied direct from Sun.
products.descriptionLong:
A cartridge that stays open at start-up to purge trapped air and let the pump prime, then closes once flow and pressure are established. It reduces the power needed to start blocked-centre circuits.

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in one version:

  • NQEB — series 2, T-3A cavity, 4 - 50 gpm (15 - 200 L/min)

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series.

Ratings

  • Maximum operating pressure: 5000 psi (350 bar)

Configuration options

The letters after the base model code choose these options (shown for NQEB; a size may add or drop a choice):

  • Control: X — Not Adjustable
  • Seal material: N — Buna-N, V — Viton, E — EPDM
  • Material / coating: /AP — Stainless Steel, Passivated, /LH — Mild Steel, Zinc-Nickel

Option rules: If the modifier is /AP, the control must be X; If the modifier is /LH, the control must be X; If the seal is E, the control must be X.

Selection notes

  • Needs at least 4 gpm (15 L/min) and 80 psi (5.5 bar) to close.
  • It opens again if system pressure drops under 25 psi (1.7 bar).
  • After purging, it closes in about 12 seconds at 4 gpm, down to half a second at 50 gpm.

Where it is used

Blocked-centre and pressure-compensated circuits that are hard to prime or carry entrained air.

Installation and seal kits

products.descriptionLong:
A multi-function cartridge: a normally closed modulating element that, with an external orifice, works as a bypass compensator — the orifice sets a priority flow into the circuit and the rest goes to tank at port 2 — and also relieves the inlet once it reaches the setting. Two functions, one cavity.

This version

Sizes and cavities

  • RVGB — series 3, T-17A cavity, 40 gpm (160 L/min)
  • RVIB — series 4, T-19A cavity, 80 gpm (320 L/min)

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series.

products.title: Sun Hydraulics 2-Port Energy Harvester Valve — EVEC
products.descriptionShort: Sun Hydraulics 2-Port Energy Harvester Valve: EVEC, series 3, T-16A cavity. Authorised Sun Hydraulics distributor, UAE — supplied direct from Sun.
products.descriptionLong:
A cartridge that turns return-line flow into electrical power: oil passing from port 1 to port 2 drives a generator that puts out 3-phase AC, rectified to up to 30 VDC. It powers sensors and electronics on a machine without running cables to them.

Sizes and cavities

Sun Hydraulics builds this valve in one version:

  • EVEC — series 3, T-16A cavity

Sun builds its cartridges in frame sizes called series. The series fixes the cavity the valve screws into, so every function in one series shares that cavity, and a larger series carries more flow. Choose the smallest series that passes your flow at an acceptable pressure drop, using the performance curves, then the configuration options. If you are replacing a valve, the model code stamped on it gives the series and function directly, and the seal kits listed further down fit that series.

Configuration options

The letters after the base model code choose these options (shown for EVEC; a size may add or drop a choice):

  • Control: X — Standard
  • Setting range: X — No Check
  • Seal material: V — Viton

Selection notes

  • It needs at least 10 gpm to harvest power and takes up to 50 gpm; port 2 is limited to 200 psi (14 bar), so fit it in a return line.
  • The drain must run by gravity at atmospheric pressure; mount it upright or horizontal with the drain down.
  • The power cable and mating connector are not included.

Where it is used

Powering wireless sensors, valve electronics and monitoring on remote manifolds and moving machinery.

Installation and seal kits

Hex 1 1/4 in. (31,8 mm); installation torque 150 - 160 lbf ft (203 - 217 Nm). Replacement seal kits — series 3: Viton: 990316006.

Ordering

Indus Hydraulics is an authorised Sun Hydraulics distributor in the UAE and supplies the range direct from Sun Hydraulics. Quote the base model and its configuration letters — for example EVECXXV — or describe the duty and we select the part. We confirm the full ordering code with the quotation.

Sun names each cavity with a T-number (T-11A, T-2A and so on); every cartridge of one series and port count fits the same cavity. Pick the row whose cavity matches the one machined in your manifold — the cavity is given on the manifold drawing, or by the model code of the valve that came out of it.

Ratings

  • Maximum operating pressure: 5000 psi (350 bar), 3000 psi (210 bar)

Configuration options

The letters after the base model code choose these options (shown for XMOB; a size may add or drop a choice):

  • Seal material: N — Buna-N, V — Viton

Selection notes

  • Choose the plug by the cavity and the port arrangement you need; each row names both.
  • EPDM seals are for phosphate-ester fluids only.

Where it is used

Unused cavities in standard manifolds, permanent connections in place of a valve, test and gauge points.

faqs.question: Why fit a cavity plug?
faqs.answer: To close off a cavity that the circuit does not need, to connect ports permanently in place of a valve, or to run a manifold without one of its functions while testing. The plug seals like a cartridge and fits the same cavity.

faqs.question: What does the full Sun model code mean?
faqs.answer: The four letters are the base model: valve type, frame size and variant. The letters that follow choose the control, setting range, seal material and any material or coating option. We confirm the full code, for example XMOBXXN, with the quotation.

faqs.question: How do I order or get a quotation?
faqs.answer: Send us the Sun model code — from the valve itself or the machine drawing — with the quantity, or describe the duty if you are choosing a new valve. We confirm the full ordering code, price and delivery with the quotation. Indus Hydraulics is an authorised Sun Hydraulics distributor in the UAE.

faqs.question: How is the cartridge installed?
faqs.answer: It screws into a cavity machined to Sun's drawing for its series, and is tightened to the installation torque given in the specifications. Main stages with an integral T-8A pilot cavity go in first, and the pilot cartridge is then fitted into them to its own torque.
